latestVersion.changelog:
text-to-video-mod 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Convert up to 150-word text descriptions or scripts into 1080p ready-to-share video clips in 1–2 minutes.
- API-based workflow: handles session creation, file upload, editing, and export behind the scenes.
- Simple prompt system — just describe the video you want; no timeline, export settings, or technical steps required.
- Supports a variety of formats for export: mp4, mov, gif, webm, audio, and image types.
- Built-in credit and session management, including error handling for common issues.
- Guidance and conversational tips for best results; supports iterative editing and batch processing.
